<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary deadlock:</strong> The Monsoon session has remained unprorogued for a record 88 days, while Home Minister Amit Shah has offered a special session on the Special India Report (SIR) following a debate challenge from Rahul Gandhi.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Congress performance review:</strong> The Maharashtra Congress is implementing a new system to track the work of its leaders, a move intended to determine future appointments and organizational roles ahead of the 2029 elections.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Governance and political rhetoric:</strong> BJP leadership has criticized the Congress for allegedly mocking Parliament, while party officials continue to urge the Opposition to support the government on critical national issues.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTFBVUkZTQzNCakNhbVNFQy1abFozd0x2X2NxcEt0SW5zTE40SEptQko2djZYcEozVXBhSTJFSE54WFI0dmQ0TlUxX2EtVUdjRnRNX3VB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial interventions:</strong> The Supreme Court has intervened in administrative and legal matters, including directing Rajasthan to frame financial assistance policies for industries and protecting a judicial officer from adverse integrity remarks.</li>
</ul>
